replication.target_description: 2014 Afghan election district-level replication: four claims, multiple logit/OLS models, linear/squared violence terms and fraud outcomes; row correspondence unresolved.

notes: Identity assessment: canonical text identifies SOURCE_URL https://osf.io/download/8mqzu/, SCORE Report - Weidmann_BritJournPoliSci_2013_JRpA - Zhang - 2g7ky.docx, replication team Yinxian Zhang, SCORE RR ID 2g7ky and OSF Project https://osf.io/bcqem. These match the neutral replication project, investigator, identifier and file URL. The original-study reference names Weidmann and Callen, Violence and Election Fraud: Evidence from Afghanistan, 2013, doi:10.1017/S0007123412000191 (input uses 2012). Primary final replication report, not preregistration or secondary commentary. Full listed multi-author repository citation/date is not independently printed. Text contains claim evaluations, general discussion, additional analyses, materials and references; referenced Tables 2–4 and full notebook outputs are not present. No PDF supplied. Neither assigned row has a description, study identifier or locator distinguishing claims, models, terms or outcomes. No target assignment from row order, audit_id, numeric agreement or metric label. Candidate evidence ONLY: Model 1 / 7oy1jv last-digit logit election violence: unstandardized log-odds linear 21.22, p =0.000, robust SE 5.07; squared -92.44, p =0.013, SE 37.33; authors say replicated. Model 2 / zxz13n last-digit logit two-month violence: linear 2.63, p =0.007, SE 0.98; squared -1.18, p =0.011, SE 0.46; authors say replicated. Model 3 / l8j9xn recount OLS, main large_discrepancy_share: unstandardized linear 0.32, p =0.394; squared -0.71, p =0.247; authors say NOT replicated. Model 3 squared variable is printed np.power(sigact_60r, 2) despite the election-violence inferential description; internal inconsistency preserved. Model 4 / 6ryjx7 recount OLS main large_discrepancy_share, two-month violence: linear 0.17, p =0.077; squared -0.06, p =0.169. Supplementary 4b invalidate_share: linear 0.22, p =0.000; squared -0.075, p =0.000. Supplementary 4d not_validated_share: linear 0.28, p =0.004; squared -0.099, p =0.011. Authors say Claim 4 replicated only for those two alternatives. Additional regional-command-clustered analyses give other p values: Model 3d linear 0.60, p =0.021 (printed subscript beta4b is internally inconsistent); Model 4b linear 0.22, p =0.009 and squared -0.075, p =0.011; Model 4d linear 0.28, p =0.002 and squared -0.099, p =0.028. These additional p values must not be mixed with province-clustered main tests. Printed p equalities/precision, including 0.000, preserved; no effect conversion or OR exponentiation. Analytic units are districts. Province N=34 and regional-command N=6 are cluster counts, not analytic district N. N=342 concerns original 2009 sampled boxes. No explicit target-model district N or mutually exclusive final district groups supplied; no arithmetic sum. All assigned unfinished fields examined together. Core values remain null because correspondence is unresolved. Unassigned original side is a placeholder; no original primary source was examined. Referenced external materials not accessed.
